# awesome-claude-design (local install)

Upstream: https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-claude-design

The GitHub repo is a catalog of DESIGN.md inspirations (links to getdesign.md). The DESIGN.md files themselves are not stored as blobs in that repo.

This folder contains:

- `README.md` — catalog and usage notes from VoltAgent
- `LICENSE` — MIT for the catalog
- `hashicorp.DESIGN.md` — HashiCorp-inspired tokens (infra / ops aesthetic), fetched as a starting point

The **project source of truth** for UI work is `/DESIGN.md` at the repo root (InterROS Postfix Admin). It is an original system inspired by the HashiCorp catalog entry, not a 1:1 brand clone.

To pick another inspiration later, download a DESIGN.md from the catalog and either replace `DESIGN.md` or keep it under `vendor/awesome-claude-design/` and adapt tokens.
